scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*|npm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm, or npm only as the Hostinger bootstrap package manager" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in npm/*) npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 install --frozen-lockfile && npx --yes pnpm@10.33.0 run build:workspace ;; *) pnpm run build:workspace ;; esac'
scripts.build:workspace: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node ./scripts/prepare-hostinger.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
